answer_1.quote: We have developed a benchmark for assessing whether LLMs generate high-quality questions in the field of education... We draw on Anderson and Krathwohl's educational taxonomy to prompt LLMs to generate questions at six levels for each context.

answer_2.quote: We have also designed four evaluation metrics: consistency, relevance, coverage, and representativeness, to assess the value of questions posed by LLMs in the educational domain.

answer_3.quote: We adopt GPT-4 to score each question three times. A question that scores 1 in two out of three instances meets the metric's requirement.
methods: scoring each generated question with GPT-4 using three independent runs and majority voting

answer_4.quote: We enlist the help of three graduate students specializing in education... We also consult ten experts in education to rate the effectiveness of these metrics... Human annotators scored the generated questions using the same criteria.
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators scored each generated question according to the four criteria: consistency, relevance, coverage, and representativeness.
